summary: bioAffinity Technologies filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement solely to correct a typographical error in the dollar amount registered under its at-the-market program, increasing the aggregate available to up to $5,228,226 of common stock through sales agent WallachBeth Capital under the May 22, 2025 Sales Agreement. The company has sold 114,672 shares for about $1.3 million gross since inception and $4.0 million under Form S-3 I.B.6 in the trailing year. Non-affiliate float is roughly $27.7 million; shares last traded at $2.91 on October 30, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution pace.
